# Artifact templates

Use the [common contract](../../artifacts/README.md), [schema](../../artifacts/schemas/artifact.schema.json), and [decision matrix](../../governance/decision-and-approval-matrix.md). These are governance records; application instances belong in their own repositories.

Each template includes required fields and a fictional draft example. Examples are structurally valid teaching aids with placeholder references, not valid operational evidence.

| Artifact | Template | Example |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Framework amendment | [Template](governance-baseline.md) | [JSON](../../artifacts/examples/governance-baseline.json) |
| Suite vision and strategic bounds | [Template](suite-vision.md) | [JSON](../../artifacts/examples/suite-vision.json) |
| Business requirements and acceptance criteria | [Template](business-requirements.md) | [JSON](../../artifacts/examples/business-requirements.json) |
| System requirements specification | [Template](system-requirements.md) | [JSON](../../artifacts/examples/system-requirements.json) |
| Service requirements specification | [Template](service-requirements.md) | [JSON](../../artifacts/examples/service-requirements.json) |
| System design and technology baseline | [Template](system-design.md) | [JSON](../../artifacts/examples/system-design.json) |
| Component detailed design and contracts | [Template](detailed-design.md) | [JSON](../../artifacts/examples/detailed-design.json) |
| System test plan and harness design | [Template](system-test-plan.md) | [JSON](../../artifacts/examples/system-test-plan.json) |
| Service test plan | [Template](service-test-plan.md) | [JSON](../../artifacts/examples/service-test-plan.json) |
| Project alternatives and selected SDP | [Template](software-development-plan.md) | [JSON](../../artifacts/examples/software-development-plan.json) |
| Bounded work assignment and handoff | [Template](work-assignment.md) | [JSON](../../artifacts/examples/work-assignment.json) |
| Structured review and findings | [Template](review-record.md) | [JSON](../../artifacts/examples/review-record.json) |

| Execution against reviewed test plan | [Template](verification-report.md) | [JSON](../../artifacts/examples/verification-report.json) |
| Integrated revisions and checks | [Template](integration-record.md) | [JSON](../../artifacts/examples/integration-record.json) |
